nodes.label: --update (incremental re-extraction)
nodes.rationale: Re-extracts only new/changed files via detect_incremental and build_merge, skipping LLM semantic extraction entirely when all changed files are code.

nodes.label: --cluster-only
nodes.rationale: Self-contained re-clustering on the existing graph; must not re-run later pipeline steps because those read intermediate files a prior build's cleanup already deleted.
